protocol.authorization: User requested trying other approaches including RL after completed engineering studies.
protocol.hypothesis: Direct sequential reward optimization may improve actual combat, where supervised command-outcome heads mainly improved command efficiency.
protocol.features: 18 inputs: seven current features (bias, visibility, capped aim-error / target-width tolerance scaled to [0,1], width, clipped distance, health, ammo); ten previous-observation/action/outcome/age history features or ten zeros; normalized remaining horizon. Current and history PPO have identical network parameter counts, but differing information and effective capacity.
protocol.action_space: Binary fire/wait. Original rule steering and hard no-ammo/pacifist constraints are shared. No hidden state or pixels.
protocol.reward: Kill-count increase minus 1 on death minus .01 per issued-fire window. No successful-command-window reward. Primary evaluation is kills and game duration, independent of the prior .25 command utility.
protocol.horizon_handling: An explicitly observed finite 180-decision horizon. Engine end or horizon cap terminates value bootstrap; never mislabel the finite horizon as an unobserved artificial timeout.
protocol.architecture: SB3 MlpPolicy, [64,64] hidden layers, library default activation; CPU one torch thread. PPO separate actor/value networks; DQN value/target networks. Same interaction count, not identical update compute or data trajectories.
protocol.selection: Aggregate all three final fits; no best-seed or checkpoint selection. Require Center mean kill gain >= .5 and Line kill difference >= -.5 versus event-memory rules, and duration differences >= -.5 seconds in both. Among eligible families choose highest Center mean kill gain, ties by arm name. No confirmation fallback.
protocol.confirmation: Evaluate selected family and PPO-current reference (deduplicated), all three fits, plus rules and event-memory rules. No fitting, tuning, threshold changes, or fallback.
protocol.primary: Against event-memory rules: Center kills difference >=1 and interval lower >0; Line kills lower >-1; both game-duration lower bounds >-1 second. Also each episode p95 decision latency <1 ms. Four primary statistical contrasts, 98.75 percent intervals. Command utility is secondary.
protocol.bootstrap: Paired crossed bootstrap over game seeds and three model seeds; pair model replicates for learned-family comparisons. Small-replicate exploratory inference. Four-way Bonferroni only for confirmation primary contrasts; development and secondary intervals descriptive. No correction across the adaptive research sequence.
protocol.claim_boundary: A bounded test of established PPO and vanilla DQN using newly collected RL experience. Prior supervised models used different data; no matched-data superiority claim. No new RL algorithm, Bayesian RLCD, recurrent neural memory, or conference novelty claim. Center-only training; both scenarios inspected in development, so Line confirmation is fresh-seed transfer, not an unseen-task holdout.
